clauses.quote: A Teacher who remains in a building and is appointed by the DCPS Office of Human Resources to a position in another area of certification shall have his/her building seniority in that area of certification counted from the date of appointment to the new position.
A Teacher who is appointed by the Office of Human Resources to a position outside of the WTU and receives pay for it shall lose his/her building seniority as of the effective date of appointment.
